description: Run Pi's own slash commands inside a BB thread instead of paying a model turn for them. The composer menu lists every command the Pi session has loaded, including extension and prompt commands BB cannot see on its own. /session, /thinking, /model, /name and /reload answer from the addon with no model request, and terminal-only controls such as /login or /resume explain the limitation instead of falling through to the model. Needs a one-time patch to BB's installed Pi provider bundle, applied with the checked script in the repository, because BB 0.45.0 has no API for this. Linux hosts only; macOS is untested and Windows is refused.
